versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the excel-model skill.
- Generates real, formula-driven Excel (.xlsx) models (not static tables) using openpyxl.
- Creates a structured workbook: Inputs/Assumptions sheet, Calculation sheets with live formulas, and user-friendly formatting.
- Designed for use in code-execution environments (Claude Code, Anthropic API tool, or Claude.ai).
- Provides a README with model structure, editable input cells, and key formulas.
- Includes strict best practices for live modeling: no hard-coded or static values, centralized inputs, and clear user guidance.
